ANF's current model is driven by brand momentum across Abercrombie and Hollister, comparable sales, gross margin discipline, inventory control, store optimization, digital/omnichannel engagement, international growth in EMEA/APAC, and capital returns supported by a net-cash balance sheet. Digital represented about 44% of 2025 year sales, supported by more than 1 billion platform visits.

The core advantage is the combination of two refreshed global brand families, an omnichannel store and digital model, disciplined inventory/markdown management, and balance-sheet flexibility for reinvestment and buybacks.
